name: customer-results-table
title: Customer results table
description: Results per customer in a real table: who, their industry, the metric before and after, and how long it took.
docs: Pass title, rows ({ customer, mark?, industry, metric, before, after, change, period, href? }) and caption, which is required: say where the numbers come from and how they were measured. Figures are strings written as you want them. After is set heavier with the signed change beside it as a chip (a leading minus or plus adds a trend arrow, and screen readers hear 'change -41%'); the chip has a column of its own, so a long change such as '+12.5 percentage points' widens that column and never overprints its neighbour; every figure uses tabular digits. A row with href makes the customer name a link. From 768px it is a real table named by the heading, with header cells and a row header per customer and the caption under it; below that each row is a card that leads with the outcome (the metric under the name, then before and after on one line with the change beside it, then the industry and the time in a quiet line) and gives every value its label to screen readers, so a phone never scrolls sideways. mark is a small mark drawn at about 16px in a tile; without it the tile holds the first letter. labels carries the column names. Renders on the server.
